task.name: Hand_off_Dominatrix_shift
task.when: At the end of each Dominatrix shift

step.action: Review every BLOCKED, ESCALATED, and incomplete checklist line.
Record each unresolved issue and next action in 📦 Camp_Issue_Log.
Record proposed instruction changes in 📦 Camp_Issue_Log without editing the printed task card or checklist.
Brief the incoming Dominatrix on each unresolved issue and next action.

passWhen.criterion: Every unresolved issue and proposed documentation change is recorded.
The incoming Dominatrix received the handoff.
The radio is returned and charging or fully charged.

reasoning.entry: The workbook tells workers to add checklist items during a shift; controlled instructions remain unchanged and proposed edits go into the issue log for later review.
